questions.stem: Parmi les affirmations sur cette forme que propose l'extrait précédent, laquelle est la seule que le texte permette de retenir ?

options.text: Add separate primary sources for each claim

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: the passage gives the controlling distinction: each claim needs its own verifiable source; design, length, or style changes do not fix sourcing. On that basis "Add separate primary sources for each claim" is the supported choice. Option A ("Add more adjectives") fails because it confuses style with sourcing; Option B ("Increase the font size") fails because it confuses design with sourcing; Option C ("Shorten the report") fails because it confuses length with sourcing.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: What a fact-check verifies

stimulus.body: Dans une note de travail consacrée à ce point, on lit: Quatre affirmations sont proposées; une seule est conforme à ce que la note établit réellement.

questions.stem: La note ci-dessus apporte des éléments pour juger cette forme. Quelle option est réellement appuyée par le texte, et pourquoi les autres échouent-elles ?
questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: fact-checks compare claims to primary evidence and reliable sources; appearance, design, or timing are irrelevant. On that basis "Primary evidence and reliable sources" is the supported choice. Option A ("The headline's font") fails because it confuses design with evidence; Option B ("The claimant's wardrobe") fails because it confuses appearance with evidence; Option D ("The posting schedule") fails because it confuses timing with evidence.

questions.stem: Parmi les affirmations sur cette forme que propose l'extrait précédent, laquelle est la seule que le texte permette de retenir ?

options.text: It makes that issue seem most important

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: what settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: foregrounding signals importance; it does not change length, authorship, or accuracy. On that basis "It makes that issue seem most important" is the supported choice. Option A ("It fixes all factual errors") fails because it confuses emphasis with accuracy; Option B ("It changes the article's length") fails because it confuses emphasis with length; Option C ("It alters the author's name") fails because it confuses emphasis with authorship.

answer.exemplar: Judge alignment by whether the ad's language, imagery, and offer match the audience's needs, identity, and context of use.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: What a character limit does to a post
questions.learningObjective: Analyze a limit's effect on nuance

stimulus.body: Contexte du texte : A policy update with many conditions is posted under a tight character limit, leaving only the headline conclusion. L'extrait ci-dessous sert à vérifier la compréhension de cette forme. Parmi les quatre réponses, une seule s'appuie sur le texte lui-même.

questions.stem: Parmi les affirmations sur cette forme que propose l'extrait précédent, laquelle est la seule que le texte permette de retenir ?
questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: a tight limit drops conditions, leaving only the conclusion; compression does not change law or font. On that basis "The conditions disappear from view" is the supported choice. Option A ("The font shrinks automatically") fails because it confuses text with typography; Option B ("The conclusion becomes longer") fails because it confuses compression with expansion; Option D ("The policy becomes law") fails because it confuses posting with legislation.
